I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random. I said I'd noted that Marrow Agrisupply's 2026 renewal is 84 seats, and that I'm not changing anything, since he said no action was needed.

I also suggested he correct his #central-team post from this morning so the team sees the right number. I didn't open that post to check it; I'm going by his own message saying the number there is wrong.

A seat count is an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so posting it in the channel needed no approval.
